The decisive mistake was Verification_Expert's scraping code at step 5. The Survivor count it produced (67) is wrong. After 44 seasons there should be 42 unique winners, because Sandra Diaz-Twine and Tony Vlachos each won twice.

The step 1 count of 0 and the step 3 count of 192 were both caught and rejected. The 67 from step 5 was never checked against the season count, so it carried through to the final answer of 53. The American Idol scrape at step 7 was also flawed (14 winners instead of 21), but the Survivor error came first.
